description: Scan upcoming share-lockup expirations across the whole A-share market for the next N days, sorted by unlock date then unlock pct desc. Forward-looking sell-pressure radar that digest can't provide (digest is single-code). Filter small unlocks with min_pct (percentage points of total shares); pass `codes` to restrict to a portfolio instead of the whole market.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

codes.description: Comma-separated canonical codes (max 200) to filter a portfolio; omit to scan the whole market

min_pct.description: Minimum unlock pct of total shares (percentage points, default 0)

name: ownership_lockups
